messages.en: Guess who I ran into at the shop earlier!
Hafiz? He's back from Johor, right?
I've selected the file. Which button should I press?
Just press that green button, then wait a moment.
Work's been so stressful this week. I just feel like taking a break.
Let's take a quick break. Then we'll see what we can get done first.
Technology makes things so convenient these days, doesn't it? You can even pay with just your phone.
Yeah, I hardly ever carry cash anymore.
